title: docs: MCP_SERVER.md's moe.release_task section omits the optional attemptId/generation fence and its ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED refusal, which releaseTask.ts has enforced since 2026-09-11 and the launchers' outage release sends
description:
Filed by defect hunt #16 (task-151a2c54, architect-2a219562) on 2026-11-04, from the execution-identity lane. Verified at b9205914.

PROBLEM
The code fences a release; the docs say nothing about it.
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/releaseTask.ts:116-126 declares two optional inputs:
  - `attemptId` (maxLength MAX_ATTEMPT_ID_LEN): "Optional fencing identity: the attemptId moe.claim_next_task returned. A superseded attempt (the task was re-claimed since) is refused with ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED before anything is written. Omitted = unfenced, as before.";
  - `generation` (integer, minimum 1): "checked together with attemptId".
- :168-170 refuses an attemptId that is too long with INVALID_INPUT.
- :219-224 runs assertAttemptCurrent (util/enforcement.ts:183) inside the mutex, beside the ownership gates and before any write. That check is equality with the task's current attempt, so a superseded, closed or future attempt is refused STATE_CONFLICT ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED. A malformed identity is refused INVALID_INPUT.
- The fence was added in c7f65938 (2026-09-11).
- The launchers rely on it. scripts/moe-agent.sh:9077-9103 (launch_outage_release) sends the pinned MOE_ATTEMPT_ID and MOE_ATTEMPT_GENERATION and treats ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED as a refusal that is not this seat's to force. Its twin is Invoke-MoeLaunchOutageRelease in moe-agent.ps1.
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md `### moe.release_task` (:2067-2125 at b9205914):
  - its Parameters block lists only taskId, reason, handoffNote, workerId and force;
  - neither the intro nor the side effects mention attemptId, generation, ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED or the malformed-identity refusal.
  The ownership refusals RELEASE_NOT_ASSIGNEE, STEP_LEASE_HELD and NOT_ALLOWED ARE documented. A reader of the contract cannot learn that a release can be fenced.

EVIDENCE
- releaseTask.test.ts:1185, "refuses a late generation-1 release after the same worker re-claimed as generation 2, writing nothing", asserts code -32002, codeName ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED and unchanged state.
- releaseTask.test.ts:1228, "refuses a malformed attempt identity as invalid input without releasing anything".
- In a git archive of b9205914, `cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/releaseTask.test.ts -t attempt` gives 14 passed.
- A scan of the 59-line section finds no attemptId, generation, SUPERSEDED or fenc.

FIX DIRECTION (docs only)
In `### moe.release_task`:
- add `attemptId?` and `generation?` to the Parameters block, using the code's descriptions;
- add one bullet: a presented identity passes the same currency check as the step tools, before any write. That means equality with the task's current attempt; a superseded, closed or future attempt is refused STATE_CONFLICT ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED; a malformed one is refused INVALID_INPUT; omitted is the unfenced legacy path.
Edit only that section. Use your own editor, never a shell write.

FILES
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md (### moe.release_task only)
No open row edits that section at 06:01Z.

util/enforcement.ts:137-158 (validateAttemptIdentity) refuses a blank or non-string attemptId and a generation that is not a positive safe integer with INVALID_INPUT. :183-230 (assertAttemptCurrent) skips the check for a task with no attempts and refuses a mismatch with STATE_CONFLICT ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED (-32002).
